summary.text: Tim McGinnis is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 56, who assumed office in 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to Ballotpedia, his professional experience includes working as a television news anchor.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists him on the Education and Public Works Committee for the 2025-2026 session; in 2023-2024 he also served on the House Legislative Oversight Committee.
